snippet.title: Fabled - GAME TRAILER
snippet.description:
Fabled is a game made by me, Awesomeal82!
Trailer music made by @My_life101 and @kandylikekane !

Credit to epicmanleo's cat 😼

Fabled is an OMORI/Deltarune inspired RPG game that I've been working on! Here's a first look at what the game comtains...
